servers.description: MCP 服务器桥接 OpenGrok 搜索引擎和 AI，以跨海量代码库提供即时上下文。

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_BASE_URL
requiredEnv.description: OpenGrok server base URL (e.g. https://opengrok.example.com/source/)

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_USERNAME
requiredEnv.description: OpenGrok authentication username. Leave unset for anonymous access.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_PASSWORD
requiredEnv.description: OpenGrok authentication password. Prefer storing via OS keychain using 'npx opengrok-mcp-server setup'.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_VERIFY_SSL
requiredEnv.description: Verify TLS certificates. Set to false for self-signed or internal CA certs.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_CODE_MODE
requiredEnv.description: Enable Code Mode: 2-tool sandbox interface with env.opengrok.* JavaScript API. Reduces AI token usage by ~90%.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_MEMORY_TOOLS
requiredEnv.description: Register the 3 memory tools in Code Mode (memory status, read, update). Off = api + execute only.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_DEFAULT_PROJECT
requiredEnv.description: Default project to scope all searches. Can be overridden per call.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_CONTEXT_BUDGET
requiredEnv.description: Response size tier controlling token usage.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_API_VERSION
requiredEnv.description: OpenGrok REST API version. Use v2 for call graph features (requires OpenGrok 1.12+).

requiredEnv.name: HTTP_PROXY
requiredEnv.description: HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL for all OpenGrok API requests (e.g. http://proxy.company.com:8080). Also set as HTTPS_PROXY.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_RESPONSE_FORMAT_OVERRIDE
requiredEnv.description: Force a specific response format for all tools. Leave unset for per-tool auto-selection (recommended).

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_MEMORY_BANK_DIR
requiredEnv.description: Directory where the AI stores investigation notes (active-task.md, investigation-log.md). Defaults to ~/.config/opengrok-mcp/memory-bank/ or workspace-relative when set by the VS Code extension.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_LOCAL_COMPILE_DB_PATHS
requiredEnv.description: Comma-separated paths to compile_commands.json for C/C++ compiler flag and include-path extraction. Leave unset for automatic workspace discovery.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_ELICITATION
requiredEnv.description: Interactive AI Prompts — the AI pauses to ask questions during investigations (project selection, file disambiguation). Requires Claude Code v2.1.76+ or a client that supports MCP Elicitation.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_SAMPLING
requiredEnv.description: AI Sampling — allow the server to request LLM completions for error explanations and summaries. Off by default to avoid consuming premium requests (e.g. GitHub Copilot).

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_SAMPLING_MODEL
requiredEnv.description: Model preference for MCP Sampling (used for error explanation and query reformulation).

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_FILES_API
requiredEnv.description: Files API Cache — avoids re-uploading unchanged investigation notes. Requires Files API support in the MCP client.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_OBSERVATION_MASKER
requiredEnv.description: Observation Masker — prepend compact history summaries to opengrok_execute results after N turns. Disabled by default; has no benefit for clients that retain full context (Claude Code, Cursor).

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_OBSERVATION_MASKER_TURNS
requiredEnv.description: Number of most-recent opengrok_execute results to keep as full text before masking older ones. Default: 10.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_SAMPLING_MAX_TOKENS
requiredEnv.description: Maximum tokens for AI sampling responses (error explanation, query reformulation). Range: 64–4096.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_AUDIT_LOG_FILE
requiredEnv.description: Path to write structured audit events (CSV/JSON). Appends tool invocations, elicitation events, and errors. Leave unset to disable.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_RATELIMIT_RPM
requiredEnv.description: Maximum requests per minute to the OpenGrok server. Default: 60.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_PER_TOOL_RATELIMIT
requiredEnv.description: Per-tool rate limits in requests per minute, as comma-separated tool:rpm pairs (e.g. opengrok_execute:15,opengrok_search_code:30). Overrides OPENGROK_RATELIMIT_RPM for specific tools.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_TIMEOUT
requiredEnv.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds for OpenGrok API calls. Increase for slow servers. Default: 30.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS
requiredEnv.description: Default maximum number of results returned per search query. Default: 25.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_PASSWORD_FILE
requiredEnv.description: Path to a file containing the OpenGrok password (file-mounted secret for containers). Takes precedence over the OS keychain when OPENGROK_PASSWORD is unset.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
requiredEnv.description: Hard cap on response payload size in bytes. Overrides the context-budget default. Non-positive values are ignored.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_SEARCH_AND_READ_CAP
requiredEnv.description: Cap for the search_and_read compound tool in bytes. Overrides the context-budget default (2–8 KB depending on tier). Non-positive values are ignored.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_STRICT_SSRF
requiredEnv.description: When true, reject OPENGROK_BASE_URL values pointing at private/loopback IPs at startup. Default: false (warn only; per-request guards still apply).

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_JWT_ISSUER
requiredEnv.description: Expected JWT issuer (iss claim) for HTTP transport OAuth. When set, JWTs from other issuers are rejected.

requiredEnv.name: OPENGROK_GRAMMAR_DIR
requiredEnv.description: Directory containing tree-sitter WASM grammars. Overrides the bundled grammar lookup.

requiredEnv.name: HYPRUSE_SCREENSHOT_MODE
requiredEnv.description: How captures are returned: 'file' writes to XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and returns the path, 'image' returns the image inline. Use 'image' for clients that render MCP images but cannot read files, such as Claude Desktop.

requiredEnv.name: HYPRUSE_READONLY
requiredEnv.description: Set to 1 to expose only the observation tools (desktop, screenshot, zoom, ui, marks, binds, wait_for). The agent can see and narrate but cannot click, type, or launch.

requiredEnv.name: HYPRUSE_CONFINE
requiredEnv.description: Restrict input to a scope of windows and refuse everything outside it: 'launched' (only windows hypruse opened this session), 'class:firefox,kitty', or 'workspace:3,special:notes'. Unset means no confinement.

requiredEnv.name: HYPRUSE_AUTH_GUARD
requiredEnv.description: Refuse to click or type into system authentication dialogs (polkit, keyring prompts). On by default; 'strict' also refuses password fields in ordinary windows; 0 disables it.

requiredEnv.name: HYPRUSE_STRICT
requiredEnv.description: Set to 1 to refuse to act when the cursor or focused window moved since hypruse's last action, so the agent must re-read the desktop before retrying.

requiredEnv.name: HYPRUSE_MARK
requiredEnv.description: Set to 1 to make the agent's presence legible: tag every window it opens 'hypruse-owned' and flash an on-screen notice when it opens a window or captures the screen.

requiredEnv.name: HYPRUSE_CLIPBOARD
requiredEnv.description: Set to 1 to register the opt-in clipboard tool (never in read-only mode). Off by default because clipboards hold passwords.

requiredEnv.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL
requiredEnv.description: Record every tool call, refusals included, as one NDJSON line: 1 writes to XDG_STATE_HOME/hypruse/journal.ndjson, or give a path. Read it back with 'hypruse journal'. Off by default.

requiredEnv.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_MAX_BYTES
requiredEnv.description: Rotate the journal once it reaches this size, keeping one previous generation alongside it. Set 0 to never rotate.

requiredEnv.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_TEXT
requiredEnv.description: Set to 1 to record typed and copied text in the journal verbatim instead of as a length plus digest. Off by default because keystrokes are passwords; needed only to replay typing.

requiredEnv.name: HYPRUSE_DRYRUN
requiredEnv.description: Set to 1 for a rehearsal: every acting tool validates its arguments and runs every trust guard, then reports what it would have done and delivers no input.

requiredEnv.name: FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN
requiredEnv.description: System-user access token (Business Manager). Takes precedence over FB_ACCESS_TOKEN and FB_PAGE_TOKEN when several are set.

requiredEnv.name: FB_ACCESS_TOKEN
requiredEnv.description: Primary user access token. At least one of FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN, FB_ACCESS_TOKEN or FB_PAGE_TOKEN must be set.

requiredEnv.name: FB_PAGE_TOKEN
requiredEnv.description: Long-lived Page access token used as a fallback credential when no user or system-user token is configured.

requiredEnv.name: FB_APP_ID
requiredEnv.description: Meta app ID; combined with FB_APP_SECRET it forms the app access token used to authorize /debug_token inspection.

requiredEnv.name: FB_APP_SECRET
requiredEnv.description: Meta app secret. When set, appsecret_proof is attached to every call so a stolen bare token cannot be used on its own.

requiredEnv.name: FB_PAGE_ID
requiredEnv.description: Default Facebook Page ID, used when a tool call omits an explicit profile argument.

requiredEnv.name: FB_API_VERSION
requiredEnv.description: Graph API version to target. Defaults to the tested pinned version; other values are accepted verbatim as an escape hatch but are not tested.

requiredEnv.name: FB_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
requiredEnv.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds; integer in [1, 600000].

requiredEnv.name: FB_HOST_CONCURRENCY
requiredEnv.description: Maximum number of in-flight requests per Graph host; integer in [1, 64].

requiredEnv.name: FB_MAX_RESULT_CHARS
requiredEnv.description: Character budget applied by the result shaper before a tool result is truncated; integer in [500, 10000000].

requiredEnv.name: FB_WRITE_MODE
requiredEnv.description: Write gating mode: plan (validating dry-run preview, the default) or apply. It never covers the irreversible and spend tiers, which always need a per-call apply plus a plan_id.

requiredEnv.name: FB_CONFIRM_TOKEN
requiredEnv.description: Operator confirmation token for out-of-band approval of irreversible or spend actions. The server prompts through MCP elicitation where the client supports it; otherwise the caller passes this value as the confirm_token tool argument.

requiredEnv.name: FB_MEDIA_DIR
requiredEnv.description: Directory permitted for local media uploads. Unset means URL-only uploads and no local file access at all.

requiredEnv.name: FB_JOURNAL_PATH
requiredEnv.description: Path to the append-only write journal. Defaults to the XDG/%APPDATA% state path; the file is created owner-only (0600) and rotates by size.

requiredEnv.name: FB_TOOL_PACKAGES
requiredEnv.description: Comma-separated tool packages or profiles to expose (e.g. core,posts,reader, or the profiles core|all|reader|publisher|moderator|ads). Omit for the default profile, which excludes ads.

requiredEnv.name: FB_PACKAGES_DENY
requiredEnv.description: Comma-separated packages to exclude even when FB_TOOL_PACKAGES enables them. Deny wins over allow.

requiredEnv.name: FB_PACKAGES_READONLY
requiredEnv.description: Comma-separated packages whose write tools are not registered at all; the read tools of those packages stay available.

requiredEnv.name: FB_TRANSPORT
requiredEnv.description: Transport protocol: stdio (default) or http. The http transport binds 127.0.0.1 only and fails closed without FB_HTTP_TOKEN.

requiredEnv.name: FB_HTTP_TOKEN
requiredEnv.description: Bearer token guarding the HTTP transport; required when FB_TRANSPORT=http (the server refuses to start without it).

requiredEnv.name: FB_HTTP_PORT
requiredEnv.description: Port for the HTTP transport (loopback only); used when FB_TRANSPORT=http. Integer in [1, 65535].

requiredEnv.name: FB_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
requiredEnv.description: Default ad account ID (act_… or the bare numeric id) for the opt-in ads package.

requiredEnv.name: FB_ADS_BUDGET_CEILING
requiredEnv.description: Hard ceiling for any ads budget write, in minor currency units (e.g. cents). Non-negative integer; a write above it is refused.

requiredEnv.name: FB_LOG_LEVEL
requiredEnv.description: Stderr log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error. Logs never go to stdout — that is the stdio protocol channel.

requiredEnv.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
requiredEnv.description: Absolute path of a sandboxed directory where outputMode='file' may write PDFs. Unset: every tool returns base64 only (file output disabled).

requiredEnv.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR
requiredEnv.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches encrypt/decrypt, sign, timestamp, add_ltv, update_metadata, encrypted builds or file output.

requiredEnv.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_PORT
requiredEnv.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless). Unauthenticated unless PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.

requiredEnv.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
requiredEnv.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Never logged.

requiredEnv.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_MAX_INFLATE_BYTES
requiredEnv.description: Per-stream FlateDecode decompression cap in bytes (zip-bomb mitigation; default 104857600 = 100 MiB). Integer >= 1024; an invalid value refuses to start the server.

requiredEnv.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE
requiredEnv.description: ISO 8601 instant with a time zone (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) pinned as the creation date of every generated document: reproducible bytes on any host. A call's own creationDate still wins. An invalid value refuses to start the server.

requiredEnv.name: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
requiredEnv.description: reproducible-builds.org convention: integer seconds since the Unix epoch, used as the pinned creation date when PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE is unset. An invalid value refuses to start the server.

requiredEnv.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_URL
requiredEnv.description: http(s) URL of the RFC 3161 timestamp authority used by sign_pdf timestamp=true and timestamp_pdf (PAdES B-T / B-LTA). Unset: those calls fail with TSA_NOT_CONFIGURED and no network request is made. Tool arguments can never supply a URL.

requiredEnv.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_AUTH
requiredEnv.description: Optional Authorization header value sent to the TSA (e.g. 'Basic ...' or 'Bearer ...'). Never logged or echoed.

requiredEnv.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION
requiredEnv.description: 'ocsp', 'crl' or 'ocsp,crl': enables online revocation collection for add_ltv mode='online' (PAdES B-LT). Unset: that mode fails with REVOCATION_NOT_CONFIGURED; mode='offline' stays fully offline. Requires PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

requiredEnv.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS
requiredEnv.description: Comma-separated allow-list of OCSP / CRL responder hosts ('host', 'host:port' or '*.suffix'). Mandatory when PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION is set: responder URLs found in certificates are fetched only if the host matches (http(s) only, no credentials, no redirects, internal addresses rejected unless listed verbatim).

requiredEnv.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_TIMEOUT_MS

requiredEnv.description: Absolute path of the one sandbox directory: zipPath / sourcePath inputs are read from it and outputMode='file' / outputDir outputs are written under it (never overwritten; the real path of every file read and of every parent written must stay inside — a planted symlink or junction is SECURITY_VIOLATION). requiredEnv.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR
requiredEnv.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches zipPath / sourcePath inputs, file output, defaultDate='now', parallel, describe_engine or draft_governance_issue.

requiredEnv.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_PORT
requiredEnv.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port (POST /mcp) instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless, legacy fallback). Unauthenticated unless ZIPNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.

requiredEnv.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
requiredEnv.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace; a weaker value refuses to start). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Compared constant-time, never logged.

requiredEnv.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES
requiredEnv.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxEntryUncompressedSize and limits.maxTotalUncompressedSize in bytes (default 8589934592 = 8 GiB, the engine default). Integer >= 1024, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start. A per-call value above it is refused with LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED.

requiredEnv.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_ENTRIES
requiredEnv.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxEntries and scan_zip_forward maxEntries (default 100000, the engine default; the scanner's default budget of 10000 is clamped to it, only an explicit value above it is refused). Integer >= 1, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.

requiredEnv.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_WORKERS
requiredEnv.description: Operator ceiling for create_zip parallel.workers (default 8; with no explicit workers the engine default max(1, min(cores - 1, 8)) applies, bounded by this ceiling; 0 disables worker threads and keeps compression on the calling thread). Integer >= 0, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.

requiredEnv.name: UMBRIEL_ALLOW
requiredEnv.description: Comma-separated tool names or categories to additionally allow on top of the profile.

requiredEnv.name: UMBRIEL_CURSOR
requiredEnv.description: Set to 'never' to forbid the real-cursor fallback entirely (strictly cursor-free). By default clicks/drags are cursor-free but fall back to the real hardware cursor when no cursor-free path exists.

requiredEnv.name: UMBRIEL_FS_ROOT
requiredEnv.description: Sandbox root directory that the fs-category file tools (read_file/write_file/list_dir/stat_path/make_dir/copy_file/move_file/delete_file) are confined to when fs tools are enabled; open_path's path argument is honored too.

requiredEnv.name: UMBRIEL_TRACE
requiredEnv.description: File path to journal every mutating tool call as JSON Lines (tool, category, masked args, ok, observation); secret-bearing args and values are redacted. Unset = no trace.

requiredEnv.name: UMBRIEL_FFI_TRACE
requiredEnv.description: File path to a flush-before-call diagnostic journal of every COM vcall (slot, this-pointer, arg count). Each line is written and flushed to the OS BEFORE the native call, so after an uncatchable crash the last line names the faulting call. Has per-call overhead; unset = off. For debugging native faults only.

requiredEnv.name: UMBRIEL_AUDIT
requiredEnv.description: Controls the default-on stderr audit of mutating tool calls. 'off' is the explicit opt-out (reported at startup); 'verbose' also audits reads.

requiredEnv.name: UMBRIEL_REDACT
requiredEnv.description: Credential masking (default on). 'off' opts out; a regex value overrides the built-in secret shapes masked in clipboard/env/registry reads and the trace journal.

requiredEnv.name: CONFIG
requiredEnv.description: Path to your configuration file

requiredEnv.name: MCP_ALLOW_STATIC_FALLBACK
requiredEnv.description: Set to 'true' to allow HTTP startup when config.json has static credentials. Otherwise the server refuses to start, preventing silent shared-identity fallback for unauthenticated requests.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_CONTENT_MAX_BYTES
requiredEnv.description: Byte cap for the content bodies and result blocks tools return (wikitext, rendered HTML, diffs, statement and row listings). An oversized response is truncated with a trailing marker describing what was left out.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_FILE_DATA_MAX_BYTES
requiredEnv.description: Hard cap on the base64-encoded size of a get-file-data response. A transport/safety backstop; callers tune actual size with the tool's width parameter. Over-cap responses error rather than truncate.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
requiredEnv.description: Minimum severity for logger output (stderr telemetry and sendLoggingMessage broadcast). Invalid values fail loudly on first log call.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY
requiredEnv.description: Maximum HTTP request body size on the StreamableHTTP transport. Accepts size strings like 1mb or 512kb.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_METRICS
requiredEnv.description: Set to 'true' to expose Prometheus metrics at GET /metrics on the HTTP transport. Has no effect on the stdio transport.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_OAUTH_ALLOWED_REDIRECTS
requiredEnv.description: Additional allowed redirect URIs for hosted-proxy client registration: comma-separated exact URIs (which must include a host) and https prefix patterns ending in /*. Loopback, claude.ai, and verified first-party clients (ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code) are always allowed; unset means no additional clients.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_OAUTH_CIMD_ALLOWED_HOSTS
requiredEnv.description: Comma-separated additional client_id document hosts trusted for CIMD (bare host or host:port). Verified first-party hosts are always trusted.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS_FILE
requiredEnv.description: Override the default OAuth credentials store path. Default: ~/.config/mediawiki-mcp/credentials.json on Linux/macOS, %APPDATA%\mediawiki-mcp\credentials.json on Windows.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_OAUTH_NO_BROWSER
requiredEnv.description: Set to '1' to skip launching a browser during the OAuth dance and log the auth URL to stderr instead. Useful in headless environments and CI.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_OAUTH_PROXY_STORE_FILE
requiredEnv.description: Path to the hosted OAuth proxy's encrypted state file, which lets sign-ins survive restarts. Default: proxy-store.enc under the mediawiki-mcp config dir; /app/data/proxy-store.enc in the Docker image.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL
requiredEnv.description: Override the request-derived public URL used in the protected-resource discovery doc and WWW-Authenticate header. Set this when running behind a proxy that rewrites the request Host.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MS
requiredEnv.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for in-flight /mcp calls to drain on SIGTERM/SIGINT before exiting. Capped at 600000.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
requiredEnv.description: Type of MCP server transport

requiredEnv.name: MCP_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES
requiredEnv.description: Memory cap on the server-side fetch used by upload-file-from-url and update-file-from-url. Files larger than this are routed to the wiki's own copy-upload instead of being buffered by the server. Guards this server's memory, not the wiki's $wgMaxUploadSize.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_USER_AGENT
requiredEnv.description: Replaces the User-Agent header of every outbound request, which defaults to mediawiki-mcp-server/<version> (https://github.com/ProfessionalWiki/MediaWiki-MCP-Server). If you set it, give a name and an email or URL, e.g. 'ExampleBot/1.0 (bot@example.org)'.

requiredEnv.name: PORT
requiredEnv.description: Port used for StreamableHTTP transport

requiredEnv.name: POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY
requiredEnv.description: Optional. Your own Polygon EOA private key. Enables the trading tools (place_order, sell_order, cancel_order, get_open_orders, get_positions). Omit to run signal-only, which needs no key and no wallet.

requiredEnv.name: ACTUALLY_MAX_ORDER_USD
requiredEnv.description: Optional. Per-order USD cap for the trading tools (default 100). Enforced server-side against the market's own price, so a caller cannot understate an order to slip past it.

requiredEnv.name: ACTUALLY_DAILY_LIMIT_USD
requiredEnv.description: Optional. Rolling UTC-day USD cap shared by place_order and sell_order (default 500). Held in a persisted ledger, so it survives restarts.

requiredEnv.name: ACTUALLY_ENABLE_REDEEM
requiredEnv.description: Optional. Set to exactly 'true' to additionally register redeem_position. A second opt-in beyond the private key, because it submits a real on-chain transaction through Polymarket's relayer and is still in testing.

requiredEnv.name: ACTUALLY_SEARCH_FALLBACK
requiredEnv.description: Optional. Set to exactly 'true' to let check_news fall back to Polymarket's own market search when nothing in the cached set matches. Off by default: the query is built from the caller's text and leaves the machine.

requiredEnv.name: ACTUALLY_SPEND_STATE_PATH
requiredEnv.description: Optional. Where the spend ledger is stored (default ~/.actually-mcp-server/spend-guard.json).

requiredEnv.name: ACTUALLY_WORKER_URL
requiredEnv.description: Optional. Only if you run your own Cloudflare Worker instead of the shared default.

requiredEnv.name: ACTUALLY_WORKER_SECRET
requiredEnv.description: Optional. Shared secret for your own Worker. Not a private credential: the default one ships inside every client by design.

requiredEnv.name: DATABASE_URL
requiredEnv.description: Full connection string (preferred). Supports sslmode in the URL.

requiredEnv.name: PG_HOST
requiredEnv.description: Database host (fallback when DATABASE_URL is not set).

requiredEnv.name: PG_PORT
requiredEnv.description: Database port.

requiredEnv.name: PG_USER
requiredEnv.description: Database user.

requiredEnv.name: PG_PASSWORD
requiredEnv.description: Database password.

requiredEnv.name: PG_DATABASE
requiredEnv.description: Database name.

requiredEnv.name: PG_ALLOW_WRITE
requiredEnv.description: When true, execute performs writes and reads are sent directly. Off (default) is read-only: execute refuses writes and each read runs in a READ ONLY transaction.

requiredEnv.name: PG_SSLMODE
requiredEnv.description: TLS mode. require/allow/prefer encrypt without verifying the certificate; verify-ca/verify-full verify it (supply a CA via PG_SSL_CA). Unlike libpq, allow/prefer do not fall back to plaintext, so a server without TLS needs disable.

requiredEnv.name: PG_SSL_CA
requiredEnv.description: Path to a CA certificate file. Setting it by itself implies verify-full.

requiredEnv.name: PG_ENABLE_RUNTIME_CONNECT
requiredEnv.description: Register the connect_db tool (runtime credential switching).

requiredEnv.name: PG_MAX_RESULT_BYTES
requiredEnv.description: Byte budget for a query result sent to the model. Whole rows are kept while they fit; over the budget returnedRows < rowCount and truncated is true.

requiredEnv.name: PG_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT
requiredEnv.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds, applied to every session.

requiredEnv.name: PG_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
requiredEnv.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a single connect attempt (raise it for slow links or SSH tunnels).

requiredEnv.name: PG_SSH_HOST
requiredEnv.description: SSH bastion host. Setting it enables tunneling: the server reaches the database only through an SSH tunnel to this host. Needs the ssh2 optional dependency.

requiredEnv.name: PG_SSH_PORT
requiredEnv.description: SSH bastion port.

requiredEnv.name: PG_SSH_USER
requiredEnv.description: SSH username.

requiredEnv.name: PG_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY
requiredEnv.description: Path to a private key file. If unset, auth falls back like ssh: a running agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), then a default key (~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_rsa, id_ecdsa).

requiredEnv.name: PG_SSH_PASSPHRASE
requiredEnv.description: Passphrase for the private key, if encrypted.

requiredEnv.name: PG_SSH_AGENT
requiredEnv.description: true to use the ambient agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), or an explicit socket path / Windows named pipe.

requiredEnv.name: PG_SSH_PASSWORD
requiredEnv.description: SSH login password. Opt-in; a key or agent takes precedence. Prefer keys, a bastion often disables password auth.

requiredEnv.name: PG_SSH_FINGERPRINT
requiredEnv.description: Pinned host-key fingerprint (SHA256:...). Host-key verification is mandatory and set only this way: without it the tunnel refuses to connect. Get it with ssh-keygen -lF host.

requiredEnv.name: PG_SSH_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL
requiredEnv.description: SSH keepalive interval in ms; the tunnel drops after 3 unanswered keepalives, and the next call reconnects.

Set in your MCP client's configuration, the seed sits inside the governed client's trust domain. Receipts are kept in memory only; save a generate_evidence_bundle result before the server stops. Unset or invalid: a new key each start, warned on stderr. When set, even to an invalid value, AGA_GATEWAY_KEY_FILE is not read.

requiredEnv.name: AGA_GATEWAY_KEY_FILE
requiredEnv.description: Path to a file holding the 64-hex Ed25519 seed; read only when AGA_GATEWAY_KEY is unset or empty, with the same effect. A stdio server started by your MCP client runs as the client's OS user, so the file sits inside the governed client's trust domain. Missing, unreadable or invalid: a new key each start, warned on stderr.

requiredEnv.description: Ceiling for the whole process lifetime, in USDC base units. Stops a runaway loop, not just a single expensive call.

requiredEnv.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for Apple Maps.

requiredEnv.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for Apple Maps.

requiredEnv.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_KEY_ID
requiredEnv.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for WeatherKit.

requiredEnv.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_PRIVATE_KEY
requiredEnv.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for WeatherKit.

requiredEnv.description: WeatherKit only: the Services ID registered for WeatherKit (e.g. com.example.weather).

requiredEnv.description: Optional: a pre-minted Apple Music developer token (JWT) instead of signing one from the key above.

requiredEnv.name: APPLE_MUSIC_USER_TOKEN
requiredEnv.description: Music User Token for your library (official API), from a one-time MusicKit sign-in: `npx apple-icloud-mcp music-auth`. Without the Apple Developer key, ask the owner for a developer token (music-auth --print-developer-token) and run it with APPLE_MUSIC_DEVELOPER_TOKEN set. Lasts ~6 months.

requiredEnv.name: APPLE_MUSIC_WEB_USER_TOKEN
requiredEnv.description: Opt-in web-player mode (no developer account needed; unlocks rename/delete/remove/reorder): the media-user-token cookie from a signed-in music.apple.com tab.

requiredEnv.name: APPLE_MUSIC_WEB_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
requiredEnv.description: Optional override for the web-player developer token (normally read automatically from music.apple.com).

requiredEnv.name: APPLE_MUSIC_STOREFRONT
requiredEnv.description: Two-letter Apple Music storefront (e.g. us, gb). Default: your account's storefront, else us.

requiredEnv.name: ICLOUD_USERNAME
requiredEnv.description: Your Apple ID email, for iCloud Calendar, Contacts and Mail.

requiredEnv.name: ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD
requiredEnv.description: An app-specific password from appleid.apple.com → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords (NOT your Apple ID password).

requiredEnv.name: ICLOUD_MAIL_ADDRESS
requiredEnv.description: Your @icloud.com address, only if your Apple ID email is not an iCloud address (needed for Mail).

requiredEnv.name: ICLOUD_DEFAULT_CALENDAR
requiredEnv.description: Calendar new events go to when none is named (default: the first writable event calendar).

requiredEnv.name: APPLE_WRITE_MODE
requiredEnv.description: "none" = read-only tools; "additive" = also create/append, never modify, delete or send; "all" = everything (default). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

requiredEnv.name: APPLE_SERVICES
requiredEnv.description: Comma-separated services to enable (music, calendar, contacts, mail, maps, weather, itunes). Default: all.

requiredEnv.name: DISPLAY_TZ
requiredEnv.description: IANA time zone (e.g. America/New_York) for displayed times and for dates you give without an offset. Set this on a hosted server, which runs in UTC.

requiredEnv.name: APPLE_UNITS
requiredEnv.description: "metric" (default) or "imperial" units for weather (Maps distances always show both).

requiredEnv.name: APPLE_STATE_CACHE
requiredEnv.description: Set to false to write nothing under $MCP_DATA_DIR/.apple-icloud-mcp: no web-player token or iCloud discovery cache, and the rejected-password latch and spent confirmation tokens then last only as long as the process.

requiredEnv.name: APPLE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
requiredEnv.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds (default 30000).

requiredEnv.name: APPLE_DEBUG_LOG
requiredEnv.description: Set to 1 to log every upstream request line to stderr (credentials redacted).

requiredEnv.name: MCP_CONFIRM_MODE
requiredEnv.description: How confirm-gated writes (send mail, deletes, removing tracks, invitations) behave on a client with no prompt, like claude.ai: "ask-user" (default: preview + confirmToken, the model must get your OK), "auto", or "refuse". Unknown values mean refuse.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_CONFIRM_TTL_SECONDS
requiredEnv.description: Lifetime of a confirmToken in seconds (default 600).

requiredEnv.name: MCP_CONFIRM_SECRET
requiredEnv.description: Signing key for confirmTokens. Random per process by default; set it so a token issued just before a restart or redeploy still works (spent tokens are recorded on disk, so none can be replayed).

servers.description: MCP server for controlling HomeMatic smart home devices via the CCU JSON-RPC API

requiredEnv.name: CCU_HOST
requiredEnv.description: Hostname or IP of your HomeMatic CCU (debmatic, CCU3, or OpenCCU/RaspberryMatic)

requiredEnv.name: CCU_PASSWORD
requiredEnv.description: CCU admin password (same as the WebUI login). Must be set; the value may be empty for a CCU with no password

requiredEnv.name: CCU_USER
requiredEnv.description: CCU username

requiredEnv.name: CCU_HTTPS
requiredEnv.description: Connect to the CCU via HTTPS (self-signed certificates supported)

requiredEnv.name: CCU_PORT
requiredEnv.description: CCU API port (80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS)

requiredEnv.name: CACHE_DIR
requiredEnv.description: Directory for the device type cache and session persistence

requiredEnv.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
requiredEnv.description: Comma-separated allowlist of browser origins. Unset = no cross-origin browser access (default-deny). An allowlisted origin is reflected exactly in Access-Control-Allow-Origin (never '*'); the list also drives DNS-rebinding origin checks

requiredEnv.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
requiredEnv.description: Extra Host header values accepted by DNS-rebinding protection (comma-separated host:port); add your hostname when behind a proxy or container DNS name

requiredEnv.name: CCU_PROFILES
requiredEnv.description: Comma-separated names of multiple CCU targets (e.g. 'prod,dev'). Each profile takes the flat CCU_* settings prefixed CCU_<NAME>_ (CCU_PROD_HOST, ...), plus policy flags CCU_<NAME>_PROTECTED (writes need confirm:true) and CCU_<NAME>_READONLY. Unset = single default profile from the flat CCU_* vars

requiredEnv.name: CCU_DEFAULT_PROFILE
requiredEnv.description: Which profile from CCU_PROFILES is active at startup (default: the first listed)

requiredEnv.name: CCU_TLS_VERIFY
requiredEnv.description: Verify the CCU's TLS certificate against the system trust store. Only meaningful with CCU_HTTPS=true. Default false, because a CCU ships a self-signed certificate — prefer CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT or CCU_CA_CERT to verify one of those

requiredEnv.name: CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT
requiredEnv.description: Pin the CCU's self-signed leaf certificate by its SHA-256 fingerprint (hex, colons optional). The strongest option for an appliance: the connection is rejected unless the presented certificate matches. Takes precedence over CCU_CA_CERT

requiredEnv.name: CCU_CA_CERT
requiredEnv.description: Path to a PEM file holding the CCU's CA or self-signed certificate. The connection is then validated against it with standard chain verification

requiredEnv.name: CCU_TIMEOUT
requiredEnv.description: Timeout for a CCU JSON-RPC call, in MILLISECONDS

requiredEnv.name: CCU_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT
requiredEnv.description: Timeout for HomeMatic Script execution (ReGa), in MILLISECONDS — scripts are slower than plain API calls

requiredEnv.name: CACHE_TTL
requiredEnv.description: Lifetime of the on-disk device-type schema cache, in SECONDS

requiredEnv.name: CCU_RATE_LIMIT_BURST
requiredEnv.description: Token-bucket burst size for CCU requests — how many may be issued back to back

requiredEnv.name: CCU_RATE_LIMIT_RATE
requiredEnv.description: Sustained CCU request rate, in requests per second

requiredEnv.name: RESOURCE_POLL_INTERVAL
requiredEnv.description: How often MCP resources are polled for change notifications, in SECONDS

requiredEnv.name: LOG_LEVEL
requiredEnv.description: error | warn | info | debug. Logs are structured JSON on stderr

servers.description: Couchbase MCP 服务器 - 启用 AI 智能体连接到 Couchbase 集群并与之交互。

requiredEnv.name: CB_CONNECTION_STRING
requiredEnv.description: Couchbase connection string. Required for connecting to the cluster.

requiredEnv.name: CB_USERNAME
requiredEnv.description: Couchbase database username. Required for basic authentication.

requiredEnv.name: CB_PASSWORD
requiredEnv.description: Couchbase database password. Required for basic authentication.

requiredEnv.name: CB_CA_CERT_PATH
requiredEnv.description: Couchbase CA certificate path. Required for TLS authentication in non Capella clusters.

requiredEnv.name: CB_CLIENT_CERT_PATH
requiredEnv.description: Couchbase client certificate path. Required for mTLS authentication.

requiredEnv.name: CB_CLIENT_KEY_PATH
requiredEnv.description: Couchbase client key path. Required for mTLS authentication.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_READ_ONLY_MODE
requiredEnv.description: Couchbase read only mode. Set to true to allow disable write operations across both KV and query. KV write tools are not loaded and SQL++ queries that modify data are blocked. Set to false to allow data modification queries and tools.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_TRANSPORT
requiredEnv.description: Transport mode for the server (stdio, http or sse). Default is stdio

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_HOST
requiredEnv.description: Host to run the MCP server on (default: 127.0.0.1). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_PORT
requiredEnv.description: Port to run the MCP server on (default: 8000). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
requiredEnv.description: Tools to disable. Accepts comma-separated tool names (e.g., 'tool_1,tool_2') or a file path containing one tool name per line.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS
requiredEnv.description: Comma-separated tool names that require user confirmation before execution. Also accepts a file path containing one tool name per line. Requires the MCP client to support elicitation.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
requiredEnv.description: Logging level for the MCP server. One of off, debug, info, warning, error. Use 'off' to disable logging entirely. Invalid values fall back to info. Default is info.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS
requiredEnv.description: Comma-separated list of log destinations. Allowed values: stderr, file. Include 'file' to write per-level log files; include 'stderr' to write to the console. Default is stderr.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_LOG_FILE
requiredEnv.description: Base path for the per-level log files. One rotating file is written per level (e.g. mcp_server.info.log, mcp_server.error.log). Only used when 'file' is in CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS. Default is mcp_server.log.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
requiredEnv.description: Global maximum size in MB per-level log file before it rotates, inherited by every level unless overridden by a per-level CB_MCP_LOG_<LEVEL>_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default (1 MB) with a startup warning. Default is 1 (1 MB).

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_LOG_MAX_BYTES
requiredEnv.description: [DEPRECATED] Global rotation size in bytes; use CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB (MB) instead. Still honored for backward compatibility but ignored when CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB is also set. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default with a startup warning.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ERROR_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
requiredEnv.description: Rotation size in MB for the ERROR log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for ERROR; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_LOG_WARNING_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
requiredEnv.description: Rotation size in MB for the WARNING log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for WARNING; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_LOG_INFO_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
requiredEnv.description: Rotation size in MB for the INFO log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for INFO; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_LOG_DEBUG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
requiredEnv.description: Rotation size in MB for the DEBUG log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for DEBUG; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
requiredEnv.description: Number of rotated backup files kept per-level log file, excluding the live file. Applies to every level unless overridden per level. Set to 0 to keep only the live file (still capped by the rotation size). Default is 1.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ERROR_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
requiredEnv.description: Rotated backups kept for the ERROR log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for ERROR; inherits it when unset.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_LOG_WARNING_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
requiredEnv.description: Rotated backups kept for the WARNING log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for WARNING; inherits it when unset.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_LOG_INFO_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
requiredEnv.description: Rotated backups kept for the INFO log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for INFO; inherits it when unset.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_LOG_DEBUG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
requiredEnv.description: Rotated backups kept for the DEBUG log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for DEBUG; inherits it when unset.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_JWKS_URI
requiredEnv.description: JWKS endpoint of the identity provider used to verify bearer JWT signatures. Required to enable OAuth, along with CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ISSUER and CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE. Only honored when CB_MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ISSUER
requiredEnv.description: Expected JWT 'iss' claim value. Also advertised as the authorization server in Protected Resource Metadata when CB_MCP_OAUTH_MCP_BASE_URL is set. Required to enable OAuth.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE
requiredEnv.description: Expected JWT 'aud' claim value. Required to enable OAuth.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ALGORITHM
requiredEnv.description: JWT signing algorithm. One of RS256/384/512, ES256/384/512, PS256/384/512. Default is RS256.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_MCP_BASE_URL
requiredEnv.description: Public base URL of this MCP server. When set, the server publishes RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata at <base_url>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp so PRM-aware clients can discover the authorization server. Optional.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_READ_LABEL
requiredEnv.description: Override the OAuth scope label the server treats as 'read' access; advertised in PRM and matched against the token's scope/scp claim. Use when your IdP cannot emit the canonical form. Default is couchbase-mcp:read.

requiredEnv.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_WRITE_LABEL
requiredEnv.description: Override the OAuth scope label the server treats as 'write' access; same semantics as CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_READ_LABEL. Default is couchbase-mcp:write.

requiredEnv.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
requiredEnv.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)

requiredEnv.name: RAG_GROUPING
requiredEnv.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter

requiredEnv.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
requiredEnv.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.

requiredEnv.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH
requiredEnv.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.

requiredEnv.name: RAG_DEVICE
requiredEnv.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.

requiredEnv.name: RAG_DTYPE
requiredEnv.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.

requiredEnv.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
requiredEnv.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.

requiredEnv.name: RAG_WATCH
requiredEnv.description: Enable automatic file watcher to detect changes and re-index modified files (true/1 to enable). Useful during active development.

requiredEnv.name: HF_ENDPOINT
requiredEnv.description: Explicit HuggingFace endpoint URL to use for model downloads. When set, auto-mirror detection is skipped and this URL is used directly. Useful when you have a full-featured mirror.

requiredEnv.name: HF_AUTO_MIRROR

requiredEnv.name: MCP_ALLOW_INSECURE_FILE_URL
requiredEnv.description: Set to "true" to allow plain http:// fileUrl downloads in evidence_create (default https-only). Private/internal addresses are rejected regardless (resolution-time check; see the documented DNS TOCTOU limitation in the hosted-deployment runbook).

requiredEnv.name: MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER
requiredEnv.description: Escape hatch for MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true WITHOUT inbound-token introspection: set to "true" ONLY when an upstream gateway already verifies Bearer tokens. The server logs a prominent warning and forwards tokens upstream unverified.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
requiredEnv.description: Comma-separated allowed Host headers. Empty = Host validation disabled (default). When set, requests with a Host outside the list are rejected.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
requiredEnv.description: Comma-separated allowed browser Origins (DNS-rebinding defense). Empty = reject any request carrying an Origin header; non-browser clients (CLI/SDK) send no Origin and are always allowed. Use '*' to allow all.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_API_BASE_URL
requiredEnv.description: Upstream API root. Required: your user key is exchanged for a session token against this host, and the server will not start without it.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_AUTH_USER_KEY
requiredEnv.description: Long-lived EAD Enterprise Suite user key, exchanged automatically for a short-lived session token. Use it for headless or automated access instead of an account password. (See https://www.eadtrust.eu/soluciones-legaltech/enterprise-suite/ for credential acquisition.)

requiredEnv.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
requiredEnv.description: Interface the HTTP transport binds to. Default 127.0.0.1 (localhost only). Set 0.0.0.0 to expose on all interfaces (containers do this automatically).

requiredEnv.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES
requiredEnv.description: Maximum accepted POST /mcp request-body size in bytes (default 16777216 = 16 MiB — sized so base64 file uploads within the documented tool limits fit). Oversized requests get a 413 JSON-RPC error before/while reading — closes a memory-exhaustion DoS vector in public deployments. Note: base64 file sources are capped by this limit BEFORE MCP_FILE_MAX_BYTES applies.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC
requiredEnv.description: Set to "true" for public/multi-tenant deployments. Activates Host validation and refuses to start unless (1) MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS or MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS is set AND (2) inbound Bearer introspection is configured (MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL + MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID/SECRET) or MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER=true is set explicitly (fail-closed).

requiredEnv.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID
requiredEnv.description: Client ID this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to EAD Enterprise Suite.

requiredEnv.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_SECRET
requiredEnv.description: Client secret this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to EAD Enterprise Suite. (See https://www.eadtrust.eu/soluciones-legaltech/enterprise-suite/ for credential acquisition.)

requiredEnv.name: MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL
requiredEnv.description: RFC 7662 token introspection URL for inbound Bearer verification in HTTP mode. Opt-in, and required when MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true. Leave empty for stdio (local) use.

requiredEnv.name: PORT
requiredEnv.description: HTTP port when running in hosted (HTTP) mode; ignored in stdio mode
